text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh!

A year has passed since structuring her 
training primarily around body 
conditioning.

Hishi Akebono's body had been conditioned 
to a point where she could draw out her 
power to the fullest.
choice_data_list: Shall we try taking on a big race soon?

text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm sure she can run a race 
that showcases her true potential without 
holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay, hooray! What are you running in~?

It might be quite a challenge, but since 
we have the chance, let's aim for a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's a big sprint race, right? 
Biko-chan mentioned she was running in 
that too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, this is getting exciting~♪

"One day, a few days after we started 
moving with that policy in mind."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, sorry to bother you right after 
your training! I just thought that was an 
incredible run...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You're Hishi Akebono-san, right?

I was approached by a reporter who had 
come to Tracen Academy for coverage.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see! So a yokozuna-class sprinter is 
finally making their full-fledged move, 
then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, pretty much~. 'Yokozuna-class' 
sounds so cool, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Which means, could there even be a clash 
with Biko Pegasus, who's on fire right 
now...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. I hope I can race against Biko-chan 
a lot too♪

At those words, the reporter caught their 
breath slightly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the sprint division is about 
to get very interesting!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you don't mind, may I write an 
article about what you just said...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course, of course~!

The next day, it was immediately covered 
heavily by online articles, and for a 
while after that, we spent day after day 
receiving interview requests.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
'It's become a hot topic that the Uma 
Musume Hishi Akebono will be participating 
in the Sprinters Stakes.'

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"‘With her large frame, top speed, and 
immensely powerful running style, her 
rival is—’"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"Despite her small stature, she bursts 
with full-throttle spirit, unleashing a 
razor-sharp final spurt—it's Biko 
Pegasus!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"There's a staggering 36cm height 
difference between them! I can't wait to 
see what kind of race this turns out to 
be!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. In any other sport, it's virtually 
unheard of for competitors with such a 
vast difference in physique to compete on 
the exact same stage, after all."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"That's what makes the Twinkle Series so 
interesting, isn't it? I'm already looking 
forward to the race myself."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that right? Guess I'll have to 
give it my all~!

However, afterward, a slightly concerning 
conversation took place.

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, seeing the two of them side by 
side is quite amusing, isn't it? A huge 
Umamusume standing next to a tiny one."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Indeed. They seem like an odd couple, 
which is somewhat charming, isn't it?’"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Indeed. How should I put it... sort of 
like... I think she'd be popular with kids 
too.’"

After the broadcast, perhaps prompted by 
comments, reactions viewing their height 
difference with pure curiosity began to 
increase.

text_block_list.name: SNS
text_block_list.text:
"For real, the visuals are top-tier above 
all else" "Won't even be able to focus on 
the race lol" "Might go snap some pics on 
the day haha"
choice_data_list:
(...It's being treated like some sort of 
attraction.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
? What's the matter, Trainer? Got 
something on your mind~?

I didn't think it showed on my face, but 
it seems she noticed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Or are you hungry~? Wanna make a buono 
snack together~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right now, there are carrots in the 
fridge, so I can make carrot chips!

Trying to brush it off would only make 
them worry. I honestly share the strange 
feeling I've had lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Big ol' me and tiny Biko-chan running 
together... It really is fun to watch~

"Even so, both of them are taking on their 
races with absolute sincerity, and they 
each have dreams waiting beyond."
choice_data_list:
I want you to watch the race seriously, 
not just for laughs.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I guess so~. It makes me really happy to 
hear you think that way, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I think it's lucky 
if people come just because it looks 
interesting to them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"First, we get people to come watch 
because a matchup between me and Biko-chan 
sounds exciting—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Starting from there, having people watch 
the races and think, "Wow, this is 
intense!" That's really wonderful too, 
isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's a race between me and Biko-chan, so 
you're bound to leave totally full and 
satisfied!"

Hishi Akebono spoke with great strength. 
Without a trace of doubt, she looked 
straight ahead.

If Hishi Akebono can stand so firm and 
steady, her Trainer needs to be even more 
dependable.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why? What's the matter?
choice_data_list:
Let's put on the most passionate, 
thrilling race ever!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ! Yup! Let's do our best, Trainer!

A few days later. I ended up running 
alongside Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Bono & Biko
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, right back atcha, Bono! I barely 
caught up in time—!
After such a lively training session.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Carrot Man is!?

Hearing that Biko Pegasus's favorite hero 
was coming to the shopping district for an 
event, we decided on a whim to go see 
them.

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for coming to see me! Please keep 
cheering me on!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...! Um, I... I really look up to heroes 
like you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm trying hard in my races 
now... And when things aren't going well, 
I think back to the heroes—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And then every single time, I get totally 
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why— please keep doing your 
best!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yeah! I'll be sure to remember your 
words!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Carrotman was so cool, wasn't he~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ......Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Mm, ah! Um, well...

—And Biko Pegasus looked up at Hishi 
Akebono with a somewhat solemn expression.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Bono. When it comes to racing... I 
really, truly want to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono, you know what my dream is, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course～. I've been saying that since I 
first enrolled!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You want to run races like a hero, 
inspiring courage in everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Though, to be honest, I haven't 
actually won a single GⅠ race yet.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why having Bono run with me 
makes me so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman grew strong because he had a 
rival. As long as I have Bono with me, I 
can do my best too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Racing with you makes me suuuper 
fired up too, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It feels like they're right on my tail, 
and it just makes me never wanna let them 
catch up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why, okay? By the Sprinters 
Stakes, I'll be way stronger.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm definitely going to win next time, 
Biko-chan!

Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus. Their 
presence seems to be a great source of 
inspiration for each other.

Bickering every time they crossed paths, 
or silently chasing after each other's 
backs—

Though it wasn't a relationship visible on 
the surface, the two of them elevated one 
another in their own unique way.
choice_data_list: So you're a precious rival to me.
You're a precious rival to me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yeah, yeah! Exactly! Biko-chan and 
I are rivals!

Day after day of dedicated training 
continued, all aimed toward their goal: 
the "Sprinters Stakes."
